title: Trait Manifest
description: The trait manifest for one drop. Layers compose by zIndex (lowest first). Option weights are positive integers; each layer's weights must sum to exactly 100 (enforced by the pipeline — JSON Schema cannot sum). Optional layers express absence as an option named 'None' whose file is a fully transparent PNG.

collection.description: The collection name, exactly as it will appear in metadata 'name' fields (e.g. 'Pelican Parish' yields 'Pelican Parish #7').

layers.description: All composable layers. Order in this array is documentation; composition order is zIndex.

name.description: Layer name. Becomes the metadata 'trait_type' verbatim.

zIndex.description: Composition order, lowest painted first. Must be unique across layers (enforced by the pipeline).

required.description: true: every token gets an attribute from this layer, and no option may be named 'None'. false: the layer must include a 'None' option (transparent PNG); a 'None' draw emits no attribute.

options.description: The drawable options for this layer.

name.description: Option name. Becomes the metadata 'value' verbatim.

weight.description: Selection weight, a positive integer. All weights in a layer must sum to exactly 100.

file.description: Path to the layer PNG, relative to the drop's assets directory. Forward slashes only. Must exist and match the canvas dimensions.
